_comment: Shared by tests/test_tools_literature_quotes.py and tests/workflow/classify-quote.test.js: both implementations must agree on every case. The source has orphan punctuation (',.') like the real Europe PMC text of Michaelis 2025.
source:
Neuroinflammation is apparent in affected tissues, particularly in the spinal cord,. Autoimmune responses are thought to have a key role in ALS pathology,
and it is hypothesized that T cells contribute to the rapid loss of neurons. These responses are mediated by CD4+ T cells that release IL-5 (P = 0.001) in ALS. The ﬁnding was “confirmed” in a cohort of 28 controls.
